description: Reviewed, expiring exceptions to the image scan gate of 12-deploy (infra/scripts/check-image-scan.sh). An exception covers one vulnerability in one exact package version, in staging only, until the day before it expires. Production has no exceptions. Changed only through a reviewed pull request with the owner's approval of each vulnerability.

exceptions.reason: zlib heap overflow in gz_vacate() through gzprintf()/gzvprintf() after a non-blocking gzwrite() stall. Unfixed in Debian (bug 1146895; fixed upstream). Not reachable: CPython's zlib and gzip modules use the deflate stream API, never gzprintf.
compensating_controls: the container runs as the unprivileged veda user (uid 10001) with no added capabilities
no inbound path: the security group has no ingress rule; browser traffic arrives only through the Cloudflare tunnel (AUT-201)
every other HIGH or CRITICAL finding still blocks the deploy; a different package version is not covered
staging holds no production data; production has no exceptions
exceptions.tracking: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-85091: remove when trixie ships a fixed zlib

exceptions.reason: glibc: the deprecated resolver printing functions ns_printrrf(), ns_printrr() and fp_nquery() do not enforce the caller-supplied buffer length (out-of-bounds write when printing TSIG records). Unfixed in Debian trixie (2.41-12+deb13u4, tagged no-dsa, 'Minor issue'; fixed only in forky/sid 2.43-7), so neither a newer python:3.13-slim digest nor a package upgrade removes it. Not reachable: these are debugging functions of the legacy resolver API; CPython resolves names through getaddrinfo() and never calls them, and no dependency of the API wraps them.

exceptions.reason: glibc: strfmon() and strfmon_l() can write past the caller's output buffer when a conversion uses right-justified width padding and the buffer is just large enough for the padding. Unfixed in Debian trixie (2.41-12+deb13u4, tagged no-dsa, 'Minor issue'; fixed only in forky/sid 2.43-7). The upstream advisory records no known network-facing application impact. Not reachable: CPython's locale module does not expose strfmon (only localeconv, strcoll and strxfrm), and no C extension of the API's locked dependency set formats money with it.
